senses.sense_definition: Musical instruments played by striking, shaking, or scraping, or the section of an orchestra that plays them.

examples.text: She plays <w>percussion</w> in the school marching band.
The composer added extra drums to strengthen the orchestral <w>percussion</w>.

senses.sense_definition: The striking or collision of one body against another, especially to produce sound or impact.

examples.text: The sharp <w>percussion</w> of hail on the tin roof kept us awake all night.
The device relies on sudden <w>percussion</w> to trigger the mechanical switch.

senses.sense_definition: The sound produced by the collision or striking of two objects.

examples.text: We were startled by the sudden <w>percussion</w> of heavy footsteps upstairs.
The distant <w>percussion</w> of blasting echoed across the entire valley.

senses.sense_definition: The repeated striking of an object to break, shape, or bore into it.

examples.text: The crew used a technique involving heavy <w>percussion</w> to penetrate the granite layer.
Early blacksmiths shaped molten iron through continuous <w>percussion</w> with heavy hammers.

senses.sense_definition: The striking or detonation of an explosive cap to fire a firearm.

examples.text: The hammer struck the primer, and the resulting <w>percussion</w> fired the bullet.
Antique rifles often relied on a system of <w>percussion</w> rather than modern cartridges.

senses.sense_definition: The technique of tapping the surface of the body to determine the condition of underlying organs by the sound produced.

examples.text: The doctor performed chest <w>percussion</w> to check for fluid inside the lungs.
During the physical examination, diagnostic <w>percussion</w> revealed unusual dullness over the liver.

senses.sense_definition: The outer edge or ulnar border of the hand, used especially for striking in martial arts.

examples.text: The martial artist delivered a swift blow using the <w>percussion</w> of his hand.
She conditioned the outer <w>percussion</w> of her palm to withstand heavy impacts.
